spots.name: Skinlab BTC Art Genesis V
spots.blurb: You've reached Skinlab BTC Art Genesis V, a graffiti piece by TRT21. Welcome to Merida, welcome to the art of open source. This is our first work in progress, creating a Genesis piece. We want to continue with this project year after year and expand to more locations in this city. Use your imagination as a weapon.
